segments.text: Alright, look, it's inevitable.
segments.zh: 好吧，听着，这是不可避免的。

segments.text: Some of the most dangerous materials you're going to encounter are going to happen in
segments.zh: 你会遇到的一些最危险的材料，都会出现在

segments.text: a laboratory setting.
segments.zh: 实验室环境中。

segments.text: In its laboratory safety guidance, OSHA does establish some basic safety standards that
segments.zh: 在其实验室安全指南中，OSHA 确实制定了一些基本的安全标准，

segments.text: every employer has to provide.
segments.zh: 每个雇主都必须做到。

segments.text: Here's one.
segments.zh: 这里有一条。

segments.text: Employers shall furnish to each of his employees employment and a place of employment which
segments.zh: 雇主应为其每位员工提供这样的工作和工作场所：

segments.text: are free from recognized hazards that are causing or likely to cause death or serious
segments.zh: 不存在已被认识到的、正在造成或可能造成员工死亡或严重

segments.text: physical harm to his employees.
segments.zh: 身体伤害的危害。

segments.text: What's this mean?
segments.zh: 这是什么意思？

segments.text: This means keeping your workplace free, clear, and clean of any dangerous or recognized hazards.
segments.zh: 意思是让你的工作场所没有任何危险的或已被认识到的危害，保持畅通和清洁。

segments.text: In our case, we're focused on explosive materials, chemicals, and dangerous pathogens.
segments.zh: 在我们这里，重点关注的是爆炸性材料、化学品和危险病原体。

segments.text: Manufacturers are required to furnish laboratories with SDSs, or Safety Data Sheets.
segments.zh: 制造商必须向实验室提供 SDS，也就是安全技术说明书。

segments.text: This sheet should have information that every employee will need to know to maintain the
segments.zh: 这份说明书应包含每位员工为安全维护实验室

segments.text: laboratory safely.
segments.zh: 所需了解的信息。

segments.text: This is going to include the chemical name, manufacturer info, hazardous components and
segments.zh: 这将包括化学品名称、制造商信息、危险成分和

segments.text: identity information, physical and chemical characteristics, fire and explosion hazard
segments.zh: 标识信息、物理和化学特性、火灾和爆炸危险

segments.text: data, reactivity data, health hazard data, precautions for safe handling and use, and
segments.zh: 数据、反应性数据、健康危害数据、安全处理和使用的注意事项，

segments.text: also control measures.
segments.zh: 以及控制措施。

segments.text: SDSs are really your go-to document for laboratory material safety.
segments.zh: SDS 确实是实验室材料安全方面你的首选文件。

segments.text: If you understand that a material, for example, has an explosion hazard, then that's going
segments.zh: 比如，如果你知道某种材料有爆炸危险，那就会

segments.text: to activate a new set of guidelines.
segments.zh: 启动一套新的准则。

segments.text: OSHA recommends conducting a Process Hazard Analysis, or PHA, on any hazardous chemicals,
segments.zh: OSHA 建议对任何危险化学品进行过程危害分析，也就是 PHA，

segments.text: including chemicals that can be explosively reactive with other chemicals.
segments.zh: 包括可能与其他化学品发生爆炸性反应的化学品。

segments.text: One policy here to maintain a safe and effective lab is to invite a PHA team with knowledge
segments.zh: 要维持一个安全有效的实验室，这里的一项做法是邀请一个了解

segments.text: of the explosive materials and evaluate any potential causes and consequences of fires and
segments.zh: 爆炸性材料的 PHA 小组，评估火灾和爆炸的任何潜在原因

segments.text: explosions.
segments.zh: 及后果。

segments.text: The PHA relating to explosives and pyrotechnics may include such topics like inherent chemical
segments.zh: 与炸药和烟火药相关的 PHA 可能包括这样一些主题：特定炸药或爆炸性化合物

segments.text: and physical properties of specific explosives or explosive compounds, quantity distance requirements,
segments.zh: 固有的化学和物理性质、数量距离要求、

segments.text: building design, human factors, and prior incident reports.
segments.zh: 建筑设计、人为因素以及以往的事故报告。
